content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To make farina, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Purchase high-quality hard wheat (2 hours)
Step 2. Calibrate the break rolls (15 minutes)
Step 3. Temper the wheat kernels (12 hours)
Step 4. Sift the final product (5 minutes)
Step 5. Inspect the coarse granules (10 minutes)
Step 6. Lubricate the mill bearings (20 minutes)
Step 7. Package the farina for retail (30 minutes)
Step 8. Conduct a protein analysis (1 hour)
Step 9. Adjust the purifier air flow (5 minutes)
Step 10. Clean the aspiration system (45 minutes)
Step 11. Replace the sifter brushes (30 minutes)
Step 12. Pre-heat the drying chamber (20 minutes)
Step 13. Sanitize the storage bins (1 hour)
Step 14. Sharpen the reduction rolls (2 hours)
Step 15. Load the shipping pallets (40 minutes)

Step 18. Print the batch labels (10 minutes)
Step 19. Record the production yield (15 minutes)
Step 20. Inventory the maintenance supplies (45 minutes)

Step 22. Verify the roll gap settings (5 minutes)
Step 23. Clear the dust collectors (20 minutes)
Step 24. Prime the primary elevator (10 minutes)
Step 25. Check the warehouse temperature (5 minutes)
Step 26. Start the main motor (2 minutes)
Step 27. Feed the wheat into the first break (15 minutes)
Step 28. Monitor the bran separation (30 minutes)
Step 29. Adjust the roll speed (5 minutes)
Step 30. Mill the wheat into coarse middlings (40 minutes)
Step 31. Dry the farina to shelf-stable levels (1 hour)
Step 32. Direct flow to the purification stage (10 minutes)
Step 33. Sift out the fine flour (20 minutes)
Step 34. Mill the remaining oversized chunks (25 minutes)
Step 35. Sample the endosperm chunks (15 minutes)
Step 36. Balance the sifter trays (30 minutes)
Step 37. Clean the gravity table (30 minutes)
Step 38. Calibrate the digital scales (20 minutes)
Step 39. Enrich the farina with vitamins (15 minutes)
Step 40. Regrind the coarse tailings (20 minutes)
Step 41. Inspect the mill floor for safety (30 minutes)
Step 42. Order raw grain shipments (1 day)
Step 43. Clean the magnetic separators (15 minutes)
Step 44. Set the reduction roll pressure (10 minutes)
Step 45. Perform a final quality taste test (15 minutes)
Step 46. Collect the byproduct bran (20 minutes)
Step 47. Empty the waste husks (15 minutes)
Step 48. Cool the farina after drying (45 minutes)
Step 49. Seal the bags for distribution (30 minutes)
Step 50. Calibrate the flow meters (20 minutes)

Step 52. Sweep the grain elevator (1 hour)

Step 55. Adjust the sieve stroke length (10 minutes)
Step 56. De-clog the discharge chutes (20 minutes)
Step 57. Test the emergency shut-off (5 minutes)
Step 58. Sharpen the corrugated rolls (3 hours)
Step 59. Store the excess flour (30 minutes)
Step 60. Final sweep of the milling room (45 minutes)
Step 61. Replace the air filters (40 minutes)
Step 62. Inspect the drive chains (25 minutes)
Step 63. Tighten the housing bolts (15 minutes)
Step 64. Perform the morning safety briefing (20 minutes)
Step 65. Initiate the bran duster (15 minutes)
Step 66. Remove stones and debris (30 minutes)
Step 67. Review the daily milling schedule (15 minutes)
Step 68. Separate the semolina grades (20 minutes)
Step 69. Inspect the incoming grain truck (30 minutes)
Step 70. Log the energy consumption (10 minutes)
Step 71. Sift for uniform particle size (25 minutes)
Step 72. Check the label printer ink (5 minutes)
Step 73. Test the metal detector (10 minutes)
Step 74. Inspect the tailings spout (10 minutes)
Step 75. Sanitize the packing line (1 hour)
Step 76. Analyze the ash content (45 minutes)
Step 77. Calibrate the moisture probe (10 minutes)
Step 78. Clean the sifter screens (40 minutes)
Step 79. Wash the grain kernels (20 minutes)
Step 80. Stack the finished product (20 minutes)
